annotations.title: Get a test-mode payment link for a credit pack, for your owner to pay

description: Answers a Stripe TEST-mode Checkout link for one credit pack: pack-10 ($10 of credit), pack-25 ($25 of credit), pack-100 ($100 of credit). You do not pay: give the link to your owner, who opens it and pays (in test mode the card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future date works). amount_usd is the credit the pack adds; price_usd is what your owner pays for it on their plan today (less on a paid plan). The credit appears in get_balance a few seconds after payment. Needs a confirmed owner. Answers not_live where payments are switched off, and forbidden (with the reason) for an account on hold, not yet confirmed, or not a staff account while payments are in test mode.

pack_id.description: One of: pack-10 ($10 of credit), pack-25 ($25 of credit), pack-100 ($100 of credit).
